items.title: Deceased BBC football commentator resurrected with AI for EA Sports FC: The family says it's a touching tribute, but some fans call it gross and bleak
items.excerpt: Legendary football pundit John Motson will return to the series, in AI form, in today
items.rationale: EA ships an AI-recreated voice of the late John Motson in FC 27. It is the biggest AI-voice decision of the week from a top-tier publisher, and the article covers both the estate's consent and the fan backlash.

items.title: Ubisoft staff must justify not using generative AI in pitches, report claims
items.excerpt: Ubisoft teams pitching new projects are reportedly being asked to explain how generative AI would help them make games …
items.rationale: A new internal greenlight rule at Ubisoft: pitches have to explain why they do not use genAI. This is a concrete process mandate, not more Motherbrain coverage.

items.title: The Japanese Erotic Visual Novel That's Filled With AI's Prudish Refusals To Translate Explicit Sexual Content
items.excerpt: Muv-Luv Girls Gaiden has put out a disastrous English-language version
items.rationale: A shipped commercial localization contains LLM refusal text where the translation should be. It is a concrete failure case for anyone using AI translation in production.

items.title: US Treasury official using Claude to create a Civilization clone tries to shut down worries he's too busy vibecoding during cybersecurity breach: "The computers are doing it on their own"
items.excerpt: Sam Corcos is vibe-coding Legatum, a "historical 4X on a hex map, built for people who love Civilization"
items.rationale: A senior government official is publicly vibe-coding a 4X game with Claude, which shows how far agent-built games have spread beyond the industry. The story is new and not covered in any section.

items.title: Clash Royale recruits creator of AI cheating tool to help catch cheaters
items.excerpt: Clash Royale developer Supercell has recruited the creator of an advanced AI cheating tool to help crack down on cheating in the game.
items.rationale: Supercell hired the developer of an AI cheat tool to work on its anti-cheat. This is a concrete new move in AI cheating versus AI detection, and it is a different event from the 11-15 Call of Duty warning.
